1 · Intro

When to use it.

Students and faculty often change between terms: new hours, a new manager, a new end date, or an assignment that ends.

Use the narrowest action that fits, and end assignments on time so people are not paid after their work stops.

Use this whenA term is ending or starting and a student or faculty assignment needs to change or end.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • An assignment left open past term end keeps a student or faculty member active and payable.
  • Moving a person to another position in the BU is a transfer. Do not use Change Assignment for it.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's term-change calendar and whether student assignments are ended or extended in bulk.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Changes and Approvals

Student and faculty assignment changes

Use when: A term is ending or starting and a student or faculty assignment needs to change or end. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Start at Our Workforce > Employment Info and search the person.
  2. Use a direct action for a single change.
    • One field: direct action
    • Several fields: Change Assignment
  3. To end an assignment at term end, use End Assignment in Change Assignment.
  4. Use a transfer, not Change Assignment, to move someone to another position in the BU.
  5. Review costing and fields that do not flow from the position.
  6. Submit before payroll cutoff and track approval with the notifications bell.

Watch-outs

  • An assignment left open past term end keeps a student or faculty member active and payable.
  • Moving a person to another position in the BU is a transfer. Do not use Change Assignment for it.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's term-change calendar and whether student assignments are ended or extended in bulk.
